source_note: 4张经过view_image核验的同一座大雄宝殿真实照片，独立核对全院正面、屋顶、悬山山面与六扇隔扇。绘制大雄宝殿，不是更常见的歇山顶、五铺作斗栱的毗卢殿（过殿）。弘治十六年应换算1503年，部分网站写1505/1506属于换算错误。始建公主传说未作为现存建筑断代依据。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


Subject: ONLY the Mahavira Hall / Daxiong Hall at Gongzhu Temple in Gongzhu village, Fanshi, Shanxi (繁峙公主寺大雄宝殿), the small rear main hall seen in Image2. Image1 is STYLE ONLY. Image2 gives full centered facade silhouette and proportions; Image3 gives roof and eaves details; Image4 confirms the projecting GABLED roof ends (xuanshan); Image5 gives the central doors. These FOUR photos show the SAME hall and no other hall should appear. The actual hall has exactly THREE structural bays, SINGLE EAVE, a simple overhanging GABLED roof (悬山), NOT a hip-and-gable roof. Preserve the straight decorated main ridge with two small ornamental ridge-end beasts and ONE small central stacked finial. The roofing is supported by simple horizontal tie beams; there are NO DOUGONG bracket sets anywhere under these eaves. The facade is a mostly solid plain wall, with the four timber column positions enclosed or flush against the wall; no deep freestanding colonnade. The central bay has a broad six-leaf door opening: six upright similarly sized lattice door leaves, with plain panels below; side bays are unbroken plaster wall with NO windows. Retain only a few fine representative geometric lattice outlines, no dense filigree. Keep the modest raised threshold/platform and the full building body. Remove the incense burner blocking the central doorway, both flagpoles and flags, all trees, canopy fragments, neighboring buildings, signs, couplets and inscriptions, and the stone-paved foreground. Draw the six door leaves in an orderly closed frontal arrangement based on Image5. Preserve the small empty plaque silhouette above the doorway but absolutely NO letters or calligraphy. No ornate fictitious dougong, porch, balcony, windows, multistoreys, ridge pagoda stacks or extra finials. Correct only the camera perspective gently to a centered approximately straight-on facade view, all verticals vertical, minimal visible side. Pure white wall/door/roof surfaces with delicate black contours, very few roof-direction strokes, never tiled grid or black fills. Complete building centered, full eaves/ridge/base, landscape1536x1024 with at least7percent side whitespace. Match master sparse elegant organic fine linework.

site_recommendation.name: 公主寺
site_recommendation.year_note: 用大雄宝殿弘治十六年落架重修纪年，不把寺院北魏创建传说等同于现存殿堂年代；弘治十六年为1503，非1505或1506。
site_recommendation.place: 山西 · 忻州 · 繁峙
site_recommendation.coordinate_note: Commons寺院地标39°08′53″N113°22′27″E，非殿堂测绘坐标。
site_recommendation.lede: 公主村的院落深处，大雄宝殿以素墙和简洁梁枋收住庭院。明代水陆壁画藏在三间殿内，把四方神祇绘入同一场法会。
facts: 现存大雄宝殿为明代遗构，留有弘治十六年（1503）重修纪年，清康熙年间又有修葺。
大雄宝殿面阔三间、进深六椽，单檐悬山顶，檐下不施斗栱。
殿内保存明代水陆壁画，佛教与道教神祇共同构成分层而有秩序的法会图像。

verification: 已view_image核验母版、4张实际输入照片和生成PNG；三间悬山、无斗栱的梁枋层、中央六扇隔扇、两侧无窗实墙、一座中脊刹与成对鸱吻对应实景；旗杆、香炉、树木、标识和邻屋已去除，完整轮廓未裁切。
